package fixture

// ProfileName resolves a stored name. The implementation is fixed for this
// package; callers cannot configure its storage or transformation.
func ProfileName(id string) string { return newNameProxy().name(id) }

type nameProxy struct{ next nameBridge }

func newNameProxy() nameProxy             { return nameProxy{next: nameBridge{next: nameAdapter{}}} }
func (p nameProxy) name(id string) string { return p.next.name(id) }

type nameBridge struct{ next nameAdapter }

func (b nameBridge) name(id string) string { return b.next.name(id) }

type nameAdapter struct{}

func (nameAdapter) name(id string) string { return storedName(id) }

func storedName(id string) string {
	if id == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return "Ada"
}
